svg.title: Medea seizing her son, the serpent chariot, and Jason
svg.desc: Line drawing after Karl Reichhold's 1906 drawing of the Medea krater by the Underworld Painter, Munich, Staatliche Antikensammlungen 3296 (Furtwängler and Reichhold, Griechische Vasenmalerei II, Taf. 90); the lower band, cut out and retraced.
